## Change and status

Describe the printer(s), concrete change, and whether the content is observed, tested, draft or TBD. Link the issue.

## Evidence and validation

Record source dates, public-safe checks and actual test results. Distinguish physical tests from document validation. State what remains unverified.

## Review before publication

- [ ] Full staged diff reviewed; raw backups, credentials, network identifiers, private paths and personal metadata omitted.
- [ ] Secret scan and manual privacy review completed; results recorded.
- [ ] Printer-specific start/end behavior preserved; Ender 5 S1 fresh probing remains on every print.
- [ ] Physical nozzle confirmation distinguished from software declarations.
- [ ] Any operational action has separate explicit approval; no active print interrupted.
- [ ] Future configuration changes include a private backup and rollback plan.

Owner review is required before merge. Do not deploy draft settings as a side effect of merging documentation.
